issue.standard_remedy: Map the sub-tier and qualify an alternate
issue.summary: Depends on a single-source sub-tier supplier (North America)

plan.diagnosis: Quartz Allied Packaging Inc. represents USD 1,379,201 in annual spend with 57 sub-tier suppliers but relies on a single-source sub-tier supplier in North America, creating concentration risk despite a relatively strong resiliency score of 78 and zero disruption events in the past 12 months. The medium severity (rank 3) reflects potential supply chain vulnerability if the critical sub-tier fails, even though current performance is stable.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct sub-tier mapping audit with Quartz Allied Packaging Inc. to identify the single-source sub-tier supplier, understand criticality, lead times, and which of the 57 sub-tier suppliers pose alternative sourcing opportunities

Issue RFI to 3-5 alternative packaging suppliers with comparable North American sub-tier networks to assess capability to replicate current service levels and pricing within 10% of USD 1,379,201 baseline
Negotiate contractual transparency clause with Quartz Allied requiring quarterly sub-tier risk reporting and 90-day advance notice of any sub-tier supplier changes
Qualify and onboard one backup supplier across all ERP systems (SAP, Oracle EBS, Dynamics 365, NetSuite) with initial 15-20% volume allocation (USD 206,880-275,840) to validate performance
remedy_steps.owner: Supplier Quality & ERP Master Data Team

remedy_steps.step: Implement dual-source strategy with 70/30 volume split, maintaining Quartz Allied as primary (USD 965,441) and qualified alternate at 30% (USD 413,760) to mitigate single sub-tier dependency

plan.expected_impact: Mitigating single sub-tier concentration risk protects USD 1,379,201 in annual packaging spend from supply disruption and establishes competitive tension to drive 3-7% cost improvement (USD 41,376-96,544 potential savings).
kpis: Sub-tier supplier diversity index (target: reduce single-source exposure from 100% to <50% by volume)
Alternate supplier readiness score (target: 90% capability match within 180 days)
Supply disruption incidents from sub-tier failures (target: maintain 0 events)
Cost competitiveness variance between primary and alternate supplier (target: within 5%)
Sub-tier transparency compliance rate (target: 100% quarterly reporting)
risks: Quartz Allied may resist sub-tier transparency requirements, delaying mapping audit beyond Week 3
Qualifying alternate suppliers may require tooling or setup investments that increase unit costs 8-12% short-term before scale economies materialize
Volume split (70/30) may trigger minimum order quantity issues or loss of volume-based pricing discounts at Quartz Allied on the USD 1,379,201 baseline
ERP master data coordination across 5 systems (SAP, Oracle EBS, Dynamics 365, NetSuite, Coupa) may extend onboarding timeline by 2-4 weeks and create PO routing errors during transition
If the single-source sub-tier supplier serves multiple Tier-1 packaging vendors, alternate suppliers may share the same hidden dependency, requiring deeper sub-tier verification
erp_actions: SAP: Create new vendor master record (XK01) for qualified alternate supplier with posting block removed in LFB1 for applicable company codes; update source list (ME01) to include both Quartz Allied and alternate with quota arrangement 70/30
Oracle EBS: Add alternate supplier site in Supplier Master, configure 30-day payment terms, create approved supplier list entry with allocation rules in Sourcing module
Dynamics 365: Set up alternate vendor account, assign to Packaging procurement category, configure dual-source trade agreements with volume thresholds
NetSuite: Create vendor record for alternate, establish item sourcing rules with primary/secondary designation, set reorder points to trigger split POs

Coupa: Add alternate supplier to catalog with contracted items, configure sourcing events to include both suppliers for competitive bidding, set approval workflows to flag single-source requisitions >USD 50,000
All ERPs: Flag Quartz Allied Packaging Inc. vendor master with 'Sub-tier Risk' custom field and attach quarterly sub-tier attestation requirement to PO terms
